title: Dashboard
purpose: See the work waiting for your laboratory roles, including your tickets, and the client organizations added most recently.
summary: Open a work queue for your role or find one of the eight most recently added client organizations.

tasks.title: Start on the work that is waiting
steps: Under [[Your work queues]], select the row for the work you want to open.
Select [[Queue definitions]] to see what a queue includes.

tasks.title: Start on your tickets
steps: Select [[My open tickets]] for work assigned to you.
Select [[Unassigned in my teams]] for work you can take or assign.

tasks.title: Add a client organization
steps: Select [[New organization]]. It is offered to account managers and client services staff.

tasks.title: Open a recently added organization
steps: Under [[Recently added organizations]], select the organization's name.
Select [[All organizations]] for the complete organization list.

good_to_know: Each count matches the filtered list you can open. A ticket may appear in several queues, and the client queue counts organizations.
Ticket queues count only tickets you may read. Restricted categories count for their team's members and supervisors.
Queues with zero matches still open. Queues with work appear first within each area.
Complaints awaiting my review is shown to supervisors only, and counts only complaints you may review independently.
Announcements cannot be dismissed. They disappear when they end or are withdrawn.

items.label: Announcements
items.description: Current notices the laboratory's administrators posted for staff appear first, newest first, each marked Notice or Important with a title and a plain-text message. They are the same for every staff role, cannot be dismissed, and disappear when they end or are withdrawn. Nothing appears when none is current. Announcements for the sign-in page or the client portal are not repeated here unless they were also posted for staff. Administrators manage them under Setup, Announcements.

items.label: New organization
items.description: Opens the form for a new client organization. Offered to account managers and client services staff, including the admin role's operational access.

items.label: Your work queues
items.description: Every staff role has a Service desk group. The Clients group appears for staff who manage organizations. Within each group, queues with work appear first. The desk prioritizes overdue tickets, unassigned tickets, complaints awaiting your review and then your open tickets. Each row opens its filtered list, including when the count is zero. “Nothing is waiting for you right now” appears when all your queues are empty.

items.label: Queue definitions
items.description: Opens the descriptions for the queues your roles can use. Each gives the work it contains, its status when work is waiting, and the local date and time of the oldest ticket when available.

items.label: Recently added organizations / All organizations
items.description: The eight most recently added organizations, newest first, including inactive organizations. The name opens the record. Account code, status and location (city and state when recorded) identify it. In a narrow panel the location appears beside the code. All organizations opens the complete organization list.

items.label: Queue
items.description: Select the row, including its count, to open the matching list.

items.label: Status
items.description: Queue definitions names the status and describes the work. A queue without a ticket age shows its status in the row when work is waiting.

items.label: Oldest
items.description: Age since the oldest ticket in the queue was logged. Select Queue definitions for the exact date and local time. The organization queue has no ticket age.

items.label: Count
items.description: Number of matching tickets or organizations in the linked list. The same ticket may meet more than one queue’s conditions.

items.label: Active organizations without an active contact
items.description: Client organizations that are Active and have no active contact. Status Incomplete. It opens the client list filtered to Active organizations with No active contact, and it is shown to account managers and client services staff. Add a contact on the organization's page to clear it.

items.label: My open tickets
items.description: Tickets assigned to you whose status is Open, Waiting on client or Waiting on third party. Shown to every staff role. Status Waiting. Opens the Tickets list on My open. Note: Assigned to you.

items.label: Unassigned in my teams
items.description: Open or waiting tickets in teams you belong to that nobody is assigned to. Shown to every staff role; the count is 0 when you belong to no team. Status Needs attention. Opens the Tickets list on Unassigned in my teams. Take one or assign it.

items.label: Overdue tickets
items.description: Open or waiting tickets with a service clock past due, among those you may read. Shown to every staff role. Status Overdue. Service clocks exist when service targets are configured; a ticket with no clock is not counted. Opens the Tickets list on Overdue.

items.label: Complaints awaiting my review
items.description: Complaints that have a recorded decision, are not reviewed or closed, and that you may review: you are a supervisor (the admin role counts), you did not record the decision and you have never been assigned the ticket. Shown to supervisors only. Status In review. Opens the Tickets list on Complaints awaiting review with the Awaiting review complaint filter, so the list and the count agree.

sections.title: Access and records
paragraphs: Active internal users see queues for their effective roles; admin includes the other staff roles. The sidebar offers destinations for your roles and combines them when you hold several. Client-linked users are redirected to their own portal home. Dashboard counts are live queries over the records, not saved tasks. The ticket queues start from the tickets you may read, so a restricted ticket outside your team is never counted.
